test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following programme was launched in 1999?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee scheme

solution:
The correct answer is __**Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY) **was launched in **1999.**
 
• It was launched by the** Ministry of Rural Development** to provide **self-employment **opportunities to **rural poor.**
 
• SGSY aimed to bring the **assisted poor families (Swarozgaris)** above the **poverty line** by organizing them into **Self Help Groups (SHGs) **through a mix of **bank credit and government subsidy.**
 
• The scheme was implemented in both** rural and urban areas.**
 
• **It **covered all aspects of** self-employment,** including **agriculture, horticulture, animal husbandry, fisheries,** and non-farm activities like **handicrafts, handlooms, and khadi.**
 
• SGSY was later renamed as **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)** in **2011.**
 
• **It i**s currently being implemented across the country to alleviate **poverty** and promote **sustainable livelihoods.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rural Employment Generation Programme (REGP)** was launched in **1995.**

 
 
• It aimed to create **sustainable self-employment opportunities **in rural areas through the **establishment of micro-enterprises.**
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee scheme (MGNREGA)** was launched in **2005.**
 
 
• Its goal was to provide at least **100 days of guaranteed wage employment** to every** rural household** whose adult members volunteer to do **unskilled manual work.**
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gramodaya Yojana (PMGY) **was launched in **2000.**
 
 
• ​Its goal was to provide basic amenities like **drinking water, primary healthcare,** and **primary education to rural areas.**
